<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 5,1,7,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Andra!
We found a ruin,
so we came to report!
<TALK 1><NAME 1>Yes! There was a very dazzling space.

And when I drew near...
there was a golden stone...

Moreover, not just gold,
various jewels were embedded too.
For the survey, I took photos too.

<TALK 5><NAME 10>One might call it the Golden Grave Marker...
This is a new discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,10><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>You did it, Hunter!
A huge discovery!
